title: AI Evaluation & LLMOps
description: Implement dataset-based evaluation, retrieval metrics, adversarial testing, and prompt regression tests.

data.text: Implement systematic evaluation: dataset-based testing, retrieval metrics (Recall@k, MRR), adversarial testing, and regression tests for prompts and models.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Regression tests for model and prompt changes
data.takeaway: LLMOps requires systematic evaluation. Use dataset-based testing, retrieval metrics, and regression tests to measure quality and detect regressions.
